question: Can LibRaw native half-size demosaic materially reduce fresh 1MP RAW three-stock preview resources while preserving the unchanged full-decode preview within frozen U7.3G quality and boundary gates?

protocol.sources: five exact already-retained P98 rights-cleared DNGs from five camera makes
protocol.reference: unchanged full-resolution rawpy/LibRaw decode followed by the existing 1MP linear-light area resize and shared-context three-stock render
protocol.candidate: rawpy/LibRaw half_size=True decode followed by the identical 1MP resize and render
protocol.pre_protocol_disclosure: Before freeze, an input-only feasibility smoke used all five rows and observed 2.63x-5.48x LibRaw postprocess speedups, input-level RMSE .00246-.00687, p95 .00455-.01484 and maximum new-boundary 7.67e-6. No output-level render, process-tree RSS, full product wall, replay or negative-control result had been observed. These are development mechanics rows, not hidden confirmation data.

decision.result: The half-size path is a repeatable low-memory preview mechanism with acceptable output fidelity, but it does not reliably reduce complete product-preview latency. Forward worst paired wall ratio is 1.12983; reverse median/worst are 1.03777/1.12389 against frozen .95/1.05 gates.
decision.retention: Retain only the explicit private opt-in and its negative evidence; default full RAW decode, JPEG scaled decode, final export and all historical evidence remain unchanged.
decision.stop: Do not tune scheduling, source order, thresholds, decoder settings, resize, stock parameters or output format. Do not open an adjacent RAW preview timing/cache wrapper leaf. Other materially different 12MP/24MP or target-device U4.5 mechanisms remain separately open.

claim_ceiling: Private Windows/Python 1MP RAW half-size preview negative on five exact P98 DNG files for three deterministic Look Approximations only; no arbitrary RAW, vendor/Adobe parity, calibrated camera colour, scene-to-display quality, final export, stock response, public API/package, device, release or product admission.
